cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put on our blue quiz badge before the final-round briefing. I'll make sure you're registered correctly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happens to the losing team?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Team consequences come after registration. Name first, badge second; please don't skip ahead in the briefing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll just cheer for you. I don't need a badge for that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll list you as support. Supporters wear blue too; stand with us while I give the organizer our names. We'll cover the final-round duties together.
